privacy.intro: How Jedidiah Cares Global Outreach for Women, Youth and Children treats your information with care when you visit our website, contact our team or explore ways to get involved.
privacy.title: Who this notice is for
privacy.text: Jedidiah Cares Global Outreach for Women, Youth and Children works with children, young people, women and communities to create opportunities through education, wellbeing and empowerment. This notice explains personal information connected with our website and enquiries to our team.

safeguarding.intro: Our expectations for safe, respectful participation and clear ways to raise a concern about Jedidiah Cares Global Outreach for Women, Youth and Children activities.
safeguarding.title: Care begins with safety
safeguarding.text: Every child, young person and adult taking part in a Jedidiah Cares Global Outreach for Women, Youth and Children activity deserves dignity, respect and protection from harm. Compassion must be reflected in how people are treated, how activities are planned and how concerns are heard.

donation-terms.intro: Practical terms for using the Jedidiah Cares Global Outreach for Women, Youth and Children website, sharing our content and exploring ways to support our work.
donation-terms.title: About these terms
donation-terms.text: These terms cover use of the Jedidiah Cares Global Outreach for Women, Youth and Children website and general enquiries about giving, volunteering and partnerships. Please read them alongside our privacy, safeguarding and accessibility pages.

accessibility.intro: The features that help people explore Jedidiah Cares Global Outreach for Women, Youth and Children, the limits we are working with and how to ask for assistance.
accessibility.title: An inclusive place to connect
accessibility.text: Jedidiah Cares Global Outreach for Women, Youth and Children wants people with different abilities, devices and ways of navigating to be able to understand our work and take part in the conversation. Accessibility supports our wider commitment to dignity and opportunity.
